newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Seven children killed by Vietnam wartime bomb.
newsitem.headline: Seven children killed by Vietnam wartime bomb.

text.p: Seven children died and 34 people were injured when a fragmentation bomb left over from the Vietnam war exploded in school grounds, a local official said on Wednesday.
"The hospital looks like a battlefield," said Phan Van Khai, Vice Chairman of the People's Committee in Ky Son, a mountainous district of central Vietnam near the border with Laos.
He said five children, aged between nine and 15, died immediately in Monday's blast and two died later in hospital.
Thirty-three other children and a teacher were being treated in hospital.
Khai said at least one wartime bomb explodes every year in Ky Son district, which was bombed heavily by U.S. planes during raids on North Vietnam and Laos.
